newsitem.title: UK: German states launch 4.5 bln mark 10-year bond.
newsitem.headline: German states launch 4.5 bln mark 10-year bond.

text.p: A group of 10 German federal states has formally launched a 4.5 billion mark 10-year six percent bond at a 15.5 basis points spread over Bunds, joint lead manager Landesbank Hessen-Thueringen GZ said.
The issue and reoffer price is 100.688.
The other joint leads are: Bankgesellschaft Berlin, Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank, Deutsche Girozentrale - Deutsche Kommunalbank, Norddeutsche Landesbank and Suedwestdeutsche Landesbank.

The 10 federal states are: Berlin, Brandenburg, Bremen, Hamburg, Hesse, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Saarland. The states stipulated the reoffer yield be no more than 16 b.p.
TYPE STRAIGHT ISS PRICE 100.688 PAY DATE 29.JAN.97
